items.problem: CS0579 'Duplicate assembly attribute' flood (×42) because the UWP Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs was carried into the migrated tree.
items.evidence: build-output.txt / build-events.jsonl: 42x 'error CS0579'; dev-agent message: 'This UWP-era AssemblyInfo.cs conflicts with auto-generated attributes. I need to delete it'.
items.skill_search: Grepped SKILL.md, MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md, Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 for 'AssemblyInfo', 'CS0579', 'GenerateAssemblyInfo', 'assembly attribute' — zero hits.
items.root_cause: SDK-style WinUI 3 projects auto-generate assembly-level attributes (GenerateAssemblyInfo defaults to true). The UWP project ships a hand-written Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs with the same attributes. Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 copies all .cs files verbatim, so the two collide.
items.proposed_fix: Tier-1: in Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1, skip copying UWP AssemblyInfo.cs (and any .cs whose only content is assembly-level [assembly: ...] attributes). Tier-3 backstop: add a MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md 'CS0579 duplicate assembly attribute' entry pointing at deleting AssemblyInfo.cs / GenerateAssemblyInfo.
items.generalizes: EVERY UWP C# project contains Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs, and EVERY SDK-style WinUI 3 target auto-generates the same attributes. This CS0579 collision is guaranteed on every UWP->WinUI 3 migration, not specific to Geolocation.
